## Wave 31 — The 12-Inch Line: Icons + Masterworks encyclopedia expansion (2026-10-11)

- **Scope:** encyclopedia DATA ONLY (parallel lane; wave 30 owns radar/market-briefing/preorders — none touched). The mainline 6" archive (1,904 figures / 158 waves) was audited wave-by-wave against real release history and found essentially complete through 2026 — including the 2026 exclusives bucket (92 figures: MTG Wave 2, Marvel Rivals, Maximum 2026, Retro Secret Wars wave 2, TAS wave 7, SDCC Professor X hoverchair, etc.) and every documented Toy Biz chase variant (Series 4 Goliath 3-pack, S6 unmasked Wolverine, S7 phasing Vision/Ghost Rider, S12 unmasked Wolverine/red Iron Fist/X-23/Bishop/Sasquatch, S13 unmasked Goblin/Crown-of-Lies Loki/melted Abomination, S14 gold Iron Man/unmasked Zemo/modern Falcon, S15 Genis-Vell/silver Moon Knight/Arachne/Destroyer, S5 Red Skull). The genuine gap was the **12-inch line** — entirely absent from the archive.
- **New: `MERGE-fragment-w31-figures.json`** — 35 researched figure entries as a valid JSON array, staged for the merge worker (figure data lives in the single shared `data/figures.json`, which wave 30's lane also touches — so nothing was edited in place). Entry schema per element: `{waveId, wave|null, figure:{name, notes, variant?, exclusive?}, source, verifyLive}`. `wave` carries the full new-wave object (`{id, manufacturer, series, year, baf, source}`) when the wave doesn't exist yet, else `null` (append to existing wave). Self-checks run: valid JSON, every element has name+notes+http source, zero duplicates vs the archive (`waveId::name::variant`), zero duplicates within the fragment, all new-wave objects well-formed with matching ids.
- **Contents (35 entries, 10 wave groups):**
  - `toybiz-2006-icons-1/2/3` (NEW waves, Toy Biz, 2006) — Icons Series 1–3, 14 entries: Captain America (+unmasked), Iron Man Model 24 upscale (+gold), Wolverine (+unmasked), Hulk (+gray), Venom (+unmasked/Eddie Brock), Beast gray (+blue lab-coat & glasses), Spider-Man (+unmasked). All 12-inch with "Evolution of an Icon" book pack-ins. Sources: Wikipedia Marvel Legends page (roster + accessories) + marvellegends.info checklist (Venom variant naming).
  - `hasbro-2007-icons-4/5/6/7` (NEW waves, Hasbro, 2007) — Icons Series 4–7, 11 entries: Wolverine brown suit + Thor (S4; corroborated by Jan 2007 MWCToys contemporary review "first wave of Marvel Legends Icons, including Thor with Wolverine" + retailer listings); Doctor Doom + Punisher + Daredevil red + Daredevil yellow (S5; 2007 trade-press lineup + EE/cmdstore/retailer listings — Daredevil series numbering varies by source, noted); Human Torch fiery + Human Torch phasing + Silver Surfer (S6); Cyclops + Magneto (S7; Sep 2007 trade press). Sources: marvellegends.info checklist, popculturesafari.com 2007 "new and upcoming" listings (May/Jun/Sep), MWCToys review, Entertainment Earth, cmdstore, averagejoescomics.
  - `hasbro-2007-icons-unverified` (NEW wave, Hasbro, 2007) — 5 entries, ALL flagged `verifyLive:true`: Nightcrawler, Phoenix, Dark Phoenix, Colossus (single dealer listing, actionfigureking), Cosmic Silver Surfer Target exclusive (single community checklist + dealer corroboration of a Hasbro 12-inch exclusive Silver Surfer).
  - `toybiz-2006-masterworks` (NEW wave, Toy Biz, 2006) — 4 Masterworks 3-D diorama sets (Spider-Man vs. Green Goblin, Fantastic Four vs. Mole Man, Hulk vs. The Thing, Galactus vs. Everybody); each includes 32-page comic, 10.5 in tall. Sources: Entertainment Earth Series 1 listing, popculturesafari 2007 listings, wertoys.
  - `hasbro-2026-exclusives` (append, `wave:null`) — H.E.R.B.I.E., pack-in with Mister Fantastic, Avengers: Doomsday (film) version, Walmart Collector Con 2-pack ($39.97, in stock Oct 2026 per Cycle-1 research). The archive had the Mister Fantastic entry but no H.E.R.B.I.E.

### Design input (new mandatory domain) — UPDATED: reports landed 2026-10-11 ~20:17–20:30 PDT, read in full
- Sources: `~/workspace/research_notes/web-craft-20261011-2014/report.md` (162 lines) + `~/workspace/research_notes/web-craft-20261011-2025/report.md` (168 lines, builds on round 1 with corrections: anchor positioning Baseline pinned 2026-01-13; Firefox 155 scroll-driven animations still flagged; Lighthouse 13.3 "Agentic Browsing" category with llms.txt audit; JPEG XL watch; Interop 2026 roadmap).
- **Applied in this wave (data layer):**
  1. *Machine Experience* (r1 §1 MX trend; r2 Angle 3): every fragment entry carries a `source` URL — machine-readable provenance that survives into the API/llms.txt surface; uniform validatable schema (self-checked). Clean parseable data is now a distribution strategy (Lighthouse 13.3 audits llms.txt: needs H1 + length + real links).
  2. *Guard-claused data* (r2 Angle 7, swarm.green pattern): assertion-style self-checks on the fragment (valid JSON, zero dupes vs archive, all sources http(s), wave objects well-formed) — refuse-invalid discipline at the data layer.
  3. *Cognitive load / scannability* (r2 Angle 4, COGA): figure `notes` are short, single-fact, consistently formatted ("12-inch …; …") so the eventual wave pages render as chunked scannable content with real structure.
- **Flagged for the merge/UI wave** (not implemented — data-only lane; concrete, vanilla, identity-preserving):
  1. *Anchor-positioned glossary tooltips* (r1 idea #7; r2 idea #1 — Baseline 2026-01-13, unguarded): Popover API + `anchor-name`/`position-anchor` + `position-try-fallbacks: flip-block` tooltips on variant terminology ("unmasked variant", "phasing") on the 9 new wave pages — replaces any JS tooltip with CSS one-liners; pair with `aria-describedby`/`role="tooltip"`.
  2. *Same-document View Transitions* (r1 idea #6; r2 idea #6 — Baseline since 2025-10-14): `document.startViewTransition()` for in-page filter changes on the new wave pages; cross-document `@view-transition { navigation: auto }` gated on `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference` as progressive enhancement.
  3. *Scale badge, not buried notes*: every new entry's notes carry "12-inch" — the wave-page template should render scale as a prominent badge (wayfinding, r2 Angle 4 TetraLogical "accessible wayfinding") + breadcrumb Home / Waves / {year} / {series}.
  4. *Scroll-reveal failure-mode rule* (r2 idea #5): if reveals are added, author the finished state as CSS default and layer motion via `@supports (animation-timeline: view())` — Firefox-stable visitors must see content, never blanks.
  5. *`content-visibility: auto` on long listings* (r1 idea #15): 167 wave pages post-merge stay Lighthouse-green without virtualization; keep INP near-zero (r1 §6, r2 idea #22).
  6. *URL-state-synced filters* (r2 idea #17, urzua ADR-37): shareable filtered archive views on explore/compare — vanilla JS + JSON blob, filter state in URL.
  7. *Hand-rolled SVG character viz* (r1 idea #3; r2 idea #16): per-character release-timeline/power-arc visualizations when the Icons data is folded — hand-rolled SVG, keyboard-focusable tooltips, no D3 weight.
  8. *Cognitive-load audit on merge* (r2 idea #13): the 9 new wave pages must get standard nav (run `update_nav.py` parity — no orphan pages), consistent headings, no competing inputs.
  9. *llms.txt compliance* (r2 ideas #7/#15): keep H1 + adequate length + real links when regenerating after the fold; verify in current Chrome (PSI false-negative bug).
  10. *JPEG XL watch* (r2 Round-1 update #5): no action — AVIF+WebP recipe stands; revisit hero images if Firefox 158/Chome ship JXL default-on.
